1. Describe your game in plain words at the top left, then press Build with AI.
2. Your game appears as bricks on the canvas. Each brick does one thing, like moving or counting points.
3. Drag from the right side of one brick to the left side of another to say what happens next.
4. Press Play to try your game right here. Press Esc or Stop to go back to editing.
5. Want a change? Type it in the Edit with AI box, for example "make it harder".
Keys: Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z redo, Ctrl+C copy, Ctrl+V paste, Ctrl+D duplicate, Ctrl+S save, Delete removes a brick, Esc stops the game, + / - / 0 zoom, WASD or arrow keys pan the canvas.
